integrity: The optimum and complete equality census were regenerated from the graph definition.
The published count of 980 was treated as prior art and only as an external cross-check.
No independent audit or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result is finite and specific to two uses of the seven-cycle confusability channel.
Equivalence is under the explicitly defined natural 392-element isometry group; no separate claim is made that this is the full abstract automorphism group.
The 1973 Hales publication is older than the structured date but was only month-resolved in inspected publication metadata, so no artificial day was assigned.
An obscure unindexed historical equality classification cannot be excluded completely.
title: Three natural-isometry classes of optimal two-use \(C_7\) zero-error codes
